name: Chromatic Shard damage applies Time Means Nothing's spell-damage-taken debuff (#652)
contract: Time Means Nothing 572357 applies aura 42 (proc trigger spell) on 572405 (MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_TAKEN, +10%, all magic schools), but Spell.dbc gives it ProcFlags 0 and no spell_proc row existed, so it never procced. Effects 0 (a spellmod) and 2 (MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_DONE, the +3% magic damage clause) are already native and untouched. With a spell_proc row gated on the magic class damage of Chromatic Shard (100% chance), a single Chromatic Shard hit should apply 572405 to the target.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
No Time Means Nothing debuff before any cast
Chromatic Shard's hit applies the spell-damage-taken debuff
